transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... for a long time now, I just wake up already feeling really low. It’s like there’s this heavy, gray feeling on me before I even get to the clinic for work, and it pretty much just follows me through the whole day.
Have you ever had a distinct period when you felt unusually elevated or irritable compared with your normal self?
No, I haven't. I don't think I've ever felt elevated or... unusually energetic like that. It's honestly just been this same low feeling pretty much all the time.
How long has this low mood been present without a break?

It's been about two years and two months now. It started right around the time the staffing changed at the clinic. My schedule started rotating all over the place, and... yeah, it's just been like this ever since, without any real break.
During this period, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I still like doing the things I usually enjoy when I'm not at work. I haven't really noticed losing interest in them or anything... I just have that same heavy feeling while I'm doing them.
Since this low mood began, have you felt tired or low in energy most days?

Yeah, definitely. It's like... even after a day off or sleeping late, my body still just feels completely worn out. By the time I finish my shift at the clinic—rooming patients and catching up on all the charts—I'm just done. It feels like I have absolutely nothing left in the tank to do basic stuff like laundry, or go shoot hoops, or even mess around with my electronics stuff.
Since this low mood began, have you had any thoughts about dying or killing yourself?
No, I haven't. I mean, it gets really heavy and I'm exhausted, but... no, I haven't had any thoughts about dying or killing myself. It's never been anything like that.

{"intent":"Assess for a persistent depressive symptom that would help distinguish persistent depressive disorder from adjustment disorder or an unspecified depressive disorder.","question":"Since this low mood began, have you noticed any change in your sleep?」}

No, my sleep has been pretty normal. I mean, I sleep through the night fine, and I don't have trouble falling asleep or anything. I just wake up feeling like I didn't get any rest, but the actual sleep itself hasn't changed.
Since this low mood began, have you had difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

Yeah, actually, I have. It's been pretty bad at work lately. Like, I'll be staring at a patient's intake screen and I just... I have to reread the same line over and over again because it's not sinking in. And I've even caught myself missing little details, like medication doses, or I'll just completely mix up what I was about to ask the patient next. It's really frustrating.
Is the staffing and rotating-schedule problem at the clinic still going on?
Yeah, it is. As far as I know, nothing has really changed with it. They haven't told us anything new about fixing it, so... yeah, it's still just the same mess it's been.
